options.content:
**This is the drill-down.** The Overview says *what happened*; this board says *how much it cost* and *how it was distributed*. Nothing here is repeated from the Overview.

**Totals add up every scan in the time range** — narrow the range to one scan to describe one server.

**Time here is database time** — how long the scanner waited on PostgreSQL. Nothing times the connector's own work per table, and queries run in parallel, so a scan takes less wall-clock time than the sum shown here.

**The query type selector** at the top narrows the query panels to one kind of query.

Hover the ⓘ on any panel for what it counts, what is normal, and where to look next.

panels.title: Database Time per Table
panels.description:
**Average time PostgreSQL spent answering the scanner, per table**, in milliseconds: every query of the scan (listings, columns, permissions) divided by tables scanned.

**Normal:** a few to tens of ms. Multiply by the number of tables for the database time of a bigger server; the wall-clock scan is shorter because up to 20 tables per pod run in parallel.

**Next:** 'Query Time by Type' on the Overview for which query dominates.

targets.expr: 1000 * sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(postgresql_connector_query_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) - last_over_time(postgresql_connector_query_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(postgresql_connector_query_duration_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) / (sum(sum_over_time(((last_over_time(postgresql_connector_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) - last_over_time(postgresql_connector_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[1d] offset 15s)) >= 0 or last_over_time(postgresql_connector_tables_scanned_total{namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", job=~".*postgresql-connector-be-go"}[15s]) * 1)[$__range:15s])) > 0)

panels.title: Database Time per Column
panels.description:
**The same database time divided by columns instead of tables**, in milliseconds. Columns are read together (one query per table, or per schema in bulk), so this is not how long one column takes.

**Normal:** well under a millisecond in bulk mode. If it stays flat while time per table moves, the tables got wider, not slower.

panels.title: Tables per Schema
panels.description:
**Average tables per schema**, empty schemas included.

**Normal:** any number — but databases are rarely uniform. One big schema hides inside an average; it is the one that goes to table mode.

**Next:** 'Schemas by Scan Mode' on the Overview.

panels.description:

panels.title: Query Duration — distribution
panels.description:
**How long each SQL query took, over time**, filtered by the Query type selector. **How to read it:** time runs left to right, the measured value bottom to top. Each box is 'this many fell in this range, at this moment' — brighter = more; hover a box for the exact count (Value). Colours do not identify individual items.

**Normal:** most boxes at the bottom (under 50 ms). Permission queries run once per table, so they dominate the count.

**Next:** 'Queries by Duration' beside it gives the same counts for the whole range.
